# V5 presentation tests: tutorial isolation, exact transition endpoints, and queue safety.
 page.evaluate('__qa.debugResetRound();__qa.freeze();__qa.select(2)');page.wait_for_timeout(120)
 report['tutorial']=page.evaluate(r'''()=>{const q=__qa,s=q.slots[2],e=s.engine,check=(v,m)=>{if(!v)throw Error(m)},before=JSON.stringify({grid:e.pyramid,uid:e.uid,g:e.boardGeneration,seen:[...e.seen],win:e.totalHundredths}),random=e.random,imgs=[];try{e.random=()=>{throw Error('Tutorial consumed gameplay RNG')};for(const t of [0,1000,6000,11000,16500,17999]){s.candyTime=t;q.drawCarnival(s);check(s.candyCanvas.dataset.mode==='tutorial','Missing tutorial');check(q.captureNumbers().length===0,'Real board numbers before START');check(!s.sixReachLayer.children.length,'Stale reach');imgs.push(s.candyCanvas.toDataURL());}check(before===JSON.stringify({grid:e.pyramid,uid:e.uid,g:e.boardGeneration,seen:[...e.seen],win:e.totalHundredths}),'Tutorial mutated game');check(e.boardGeneration===0&&q.sixCount(e.pyramid)===0&&!e.initialPyramid,'Premature board');check(q.SIX_TUTORIAL_DURATION<=20000,'Tutorial too long');check(new Set(imgs).size>=4,'Static instructions');}finally{e.random=random}return {durationMs:q.SIX_TUTORIAL_DURATION,scenes:4,noPrematureBoard:true,noGameplayRng:true,mainAndMini:true}}''')
 for t in [1000,6000,11000,16500]:
  page.evaluate('(t)=>{__qa.slots[2].candyTime=t;__qa.redraw()}',t);page.screenshot(path=str(out/f'tutorial-{t}.png'))
 report['transitionMath']=page.evaluate(r'''()=>{const q=__qa,check=(v,m)=>{if(!v)throw Error(m)},tile={id:3},a=q.sixXY(5,3,10);const start=q.sixTransitionPose({phase:'pyramidSweep'},5,3,tile,10,0),end=q.sixTransitionPose({phase:'pyramidSweep'},5,3,tile,10,1);check(start.x===a.x&&start.y===a.y,'Sweep jumped at start');check(!end.visible&&end.alpha===0,'Sweep not gone');for(let r=0;r<10;r++){const p=q.sixTransitionPose({phase:'pyramidRefill'},r,0,tile,10,1),b=q.sixXY(r,0,10);check(Math.abs(p.x-b.x)<1e-6&&Math.abs(p.y-b.y)<1e-6&&p.visible,'Refill endpoint');}check(!q.sixTransitionPose({phase:'pyramidRefill'},0,0,tile,10,.1).visible,'Unreleased top row visible');check(q.sixTransitionPose({phase:'pyramidRefill'},9,0,tile,10,.1).visible,'Bottom row did not enter first');return {allRowsEndExactly:true,sequentialRows:true,sweepFullyGone:true}}''')
 report['transitionEngine']=page.evaluate(r'''async()=>{const q=__qa,check=(v,m)=>{if(!v)throw Error(m)},rng=seed=>()=>((seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0)/4294967296),idle=async e=>{for(let n=0;n<30000;n++){if(!e.busy&&!e.queue.length)return;await Promise.resolve()}throw Error('Queue stuck')},fixture=e=>{const g=q.sixEmpty(10);for(let c=0;c<4;c++)g[9][c]={id:100+c,color:0,number:null};g[9][7]={id:108,color:2,number:null};g[0][0]={id:109,color:1,number:1};e.pyramid=g;e.initialPyramid=q.sixClone(g);e.remainingCandies=6;};let queued=false,e;const events=[];e=new q.SixBallCandyEngine({random:rng(34),sleep:()=>Promise.resolve(),onEvent:ev=>{events.push(ev.phase);if(ev.phase==='error')throw Error(ev.message);if(ev.phase==='pyramidSweep'&&!queued){queued=true;check(e.processed===1&&e.busy,'Not blocked during sweep');check(q.sixCount(e.fx.grid)===1,'Remaining candies not preserved');check(e.allClears===0,'Visual sweep awarded all-clear');e.enqueue(2);e.enqueue(3);}}});e.start();fixture(e);e.enqueue(1);await idle(e);check(e.processed===3,'Queued numbers lost or duplicated');check(events.indexOf('pyramidSweep')<events.indexOf('pyramidRefill'),'Bad phase order');let reset=false,f;f=new q.SixBallCandyEngine({random:rng(2),sleep:()=>Promise.resolve(),onEvent:ev=>{if(ev.phase==='pyramidSweep'){reset=true;f.reset();}if(reset&&ev.phase==='pyramidRefill')throw Error('Refill after reset');}});f.start();fixture(f);f.enqueue(1);await idle(f);check(reset&&!f.initialPyramid&&f.roundIndex===1&&!f.busy,'Reset did not cancel sweep');return {queuePreserved:true,noFalseAllClear:true,resetCancels:true}}''')
 start(page)
 report['v5Ui']=page.evaluate(r'''()=>{const q=__qa,s=q.slots[2],h=document.querySelector('#carnival-heading'),check=(v,m)=>{if(!v)throw Error(m)};check(q.sixFrameState.loaded,'Frame not loaded');check(!h.textContent.includes('シックスキャンディ'),'Main title still present');check(h.querySelectorAll('.six-round-card').length===3,'Round cards');check(!document.querySelector('.six-bonus-list'),'Full list still visible');check(h.querySelector('.six-allclear-banner b').textContent==='300000','All clear WIN');check([...s.sixOdds.querySelectorAll('.six-role-head')].every(v=>v.querySelector('canvas')&&!v.textContent.trim()),'Role labels or missing candy icons');check(s.sixOdds.querySelector('[data-role=line] [data-count="1"] b').textContent==='300','BET-denominated WIN');return {imageFrame:true,externalRoundCards:3,winAmounts:true,candyIcons:true,noMainTitle:true}}''')
 for name,phase,t in [('sweep','pyramidSweep',.45),('refill','pyramidRefill',.40),('refill-end','pyramidRefill',1)]:
  page.evaluate('([phase,t])=>{const q=__qa,e=q.app.engines[2];e.fx={phase,grid:q.sixClone(e.pyramid),elapsed:t*1000,stamp:null,ms:1000};q.redraw()}',[phase,t]);page.screenshot(path=str(out/(name+'.png')))
 page.evaluate('__qa.app.engines[2].fx=null;__qa.redraw()')
